# AMC Beam Frame

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Region Template** for Universal Theme · direction: motion · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A region frame with a beam of light that travels around its border and speeds up while the region has hover or focus.

**Use it for:** Any region that deserves attention: a key Classic Report, an approval Form, a Chart, a KPI row or a Static Content summary.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_beam_frame.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/region-templates/amc-beam-frame.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

On any region, set **Appearance > Template** to **AMC Beam Frame**. In APEXlang: `appearance { template: @amc-beam-frame }`.

Region template with a travelling border beam. Title and icon come from the region; buttons in Help, Edit, Change, Copy, Delete and Create sit in the header, and Previous, Close and Next in the footer. Template options add a second beam, success or danger colors, a slower beam, no body padding or a visually hidden header. Under reduced motion the beam stops as a static gradient border; in forced-colors mode the frame becomes a plain system border.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Dual beam | `amc-TBeamFrame--dual` | Two beams chase each other around the border. |
| Success color | `amc-TBeamFrame--success` | Beam and icon use the success palette color. |
| Danger color | `amc-TBeamFrame--danger` | Beam and icon use the danger and warning palette colors, for escalations. |
| Slow beam | `amc-TBeamFrame--slow` | Halves the beam speed for calmer pages. |
| No body padding | `amc-TBeamFrame--noPadding` | Removes side padding so reports and grids run edge to edge. |
| Hide header | `amc-TBeamFrame--hideHeader` | Keeps the title for screen readers but hides the header visually. |
